newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU crude oil and gasoline stocks fall in May.
newsitem.headline: EU crude oil and gasoline stocks fall in May.

text.p: Crude and oil product stocks in the 15 countries of the European Union plus Norway fell in May with only middle distillate levels rising, Stitching Euroilstock said in its latest monthly report.
Crude and oil product stocks combined fell by 7.39 million barrels, or 0.7 percent, to 1,081.27 million barrels at the end of May, as crude and gasoline stocks subsided.
Crude oil stocks were down 3.65 million barrels, or 0.8 percent, in May to 429.24 million barrels, leaving them 250,000 barrels lower than year-ago levels.
Gasoline inventories dropped by 5.95 million barrels, or 3.6 percent, in May to 160.99 million barrels and were 4.27 million barrels, or 2.6 percent, lower than a year ago.
Middle distillate stocks rose by 4.95 million barrels, or 1.6 percent, to 316.88 million barrels. This left them 19.54 million barrels, or 6.6 percent, higher than a year ago.
Fuel oil stocks were 980,000 barrels, or 0.7 percent, lower in May at 148.20 million barrels. This left a year-on-year surplus of 5.26 million barrels, or 3.7 percent.
Naphtha stocks fell by 1.76 million barrels to 25.96 million barrels at the end of May.
Crude intake was 190,000 barrels per day (bpd), or 1.5 percent, lower than in April at 11.711 million bpd, leading to a utilisation rate of 88.72 percent in May.
